theme.description: Hyper-realistic, hyper-formal, futuristic, premium dark mode app with deep black backgrounds and electric blue neon accents.

components.cards: Subtle glassmorphism (rgba(255,255,255,0.03)), backdrop-blur-xl, 1px border-white/10, no heavy shadows. Flat or max 8px border-radius.
components.buttons: Flat, sharp edges or subtle roundness. Primary CTAs use #00B4FF. Ensure high contrast.
components.navigation: Top tab navigation (Mineração / Carteira / Mercado / Chat / Perfil).
components.alignment: Asymmetrical layouts by default (left-aligned content), EXCEPT for the main pulsating mining button which MUST be centralized.

motion_and_interaction.mining_button: Use react-native-reanimated for hyper-realistic pulse effect and glow. Centralized focus.
motion_and_interaction.splash_screen: Pulsating neon mask with slow scale-in cinematic animation.
motion_and_interaction.microinteractions: Subtle feedback on all major actions.

image_urls.description: CRITICAL: The ONLY logo. Do NOT overlay text. Process for intense blue neon glow and deep black background.
Hyper-realistic pitch black studio background with a subtle electric blue rim light.

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5, sharp and minimalist, or @expo/vector-icons.

key_features_instructions.tech_stack_notice: CRITICAL: Project uses .js files, NOT .tsx files. Write all React Native components in .js.
key_features_instructions.splash_screen: Display the neon mask image. Add pulsating opacity/scale animation.
key_features_instructions.onboarding: 12-word BIP39 style generation and confirmation. Use dark surfaces and JetBrains monospace font for the 12 words.
key_features_instructions.dashboard: Centralized pulsating mining button. 24h countdown timer. Large balance display using JetBrains Mono (Nick King main, Beta sub-unit). Daily bonus claim section.
key_features_instructions.wallet: Clickable cards linking to external wallets (Trust Wallet, MetaMask, Binance, Coinbase, Kraken).
key_features_instructions.market: Real-time (or mocked) prices for BTC, ETH, XRP, LTC, UNI, DASH, DOT, XMR, EOS, IOTA, ADA, ZEC, NEM. High contrast numbers.
key_features_instructions.referral: Invite code generator, active invites list, bonus per invite info.
key_features_instructions.chat: Global social chat room in real-time. Sleek dark bubbles.
key_features_instructions.settings_and_about: Language selector (Default: Português de Portugal). Include 'Sobre' page with licenses, legal terms, founders (Elisabete Gonçalves, Nick Oliveira), HQ: Portugal.

testing.attributes: Add testID prop to all interactive elements using kebab-case role-based names (e.g., testID='mining-action-button').
